question: Which of the following states has the honor of being India's first carbon-free state?
solution:
The correct one is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Himachal Pradesh was declared as India's first carbon-neutral state in 2010.**
 
• The state has taken various initiatives to **reduce carbon emissions** such as promoting renewable energy, afforestation, and energy-efficient practices.
